register_disabled: The administrator has disabled new user registrations.

error_rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.

settings_apikeys_copy_now: Copy this key now. It will not be shown again:

settings_apikeys_delete_confirm: Delete this API key? Anything using it will stop working.
admin_settings_apikey_lifetime_hint: How long a new API key stays valid. Existing keys keep their own expiry date.
admin_reserved_names_hint: User and group names matching these patterns cannot be used, because they would clash with the site's own URLs. Use * for any characters, ? for a single character, e.g. user*. Built-in names cannot be changed.
admin_reserved_failed: The change could not be saved.
error_reserved_pattern_invalid: Use only letters, digits, - and _, plus the wildcards * and ?, with at least one letter or digit (max 64 characters).
error_name_reserved: This name is reserved for the site itself and cannot be used.
forgot_password_intro: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
reset_password_email_sent: If that email address is registered, a reset link has been sent.
reset_password_success: Your password has been reset. You can now sign in.
new_repo_creation_disabled: The administrator has disabled creating new repositories.
repo_name_hint: Letters, digits, hyphens and dots only.
repo_empty_start: Make a commit to get started:
settings_readonly_hint: No one, including the owner, can push to this repository anymore.
confirm_delete_repo: Are you sure you want to delete {0}?
repo_data_missing_body: This repository's data could not be found on disk. It may have been deleted or moved outside the application.
settings_collaborators_hint: Grant other users read or write access to this repository.
error_collaborator_is_owner: This user already owns the repository.
settings_collaborator_search_placeholder: Search by username, email or display name
groups_hint: Create groups of users so you can grant them access to a repository all at once.
group_members_hint: Manage the members of this group. Read: clone and browse. Write: also push and create repositories. Admin: also manage the repositories and the members.
error_group_name_taken: You already have a group with this name.
error_group_member_is_owner: The group's owner cannot be added as a member.
group_repos_empty: This group doesn't own any repositories yet.
preferred_language_hint: Automatically selected when you sign in.
timezone_hint: Used to convert dates and times on the site to your local time.
settings_no_password_info: Your account has no password (signed in via OAuth). Set a password to use git over HTTPS.
admin_password_leave_blank: Leave blank to keep the current password.
admin_password_required_to_validate: Set a password to validate this pending user.
admin_validate_hint: This user has not completed registration yet. Fill in a username and password to validate the account.
admin_users_filter_placeholder: Filter by username, display name or email...
error_invalid_repo_name: Invalid name. Use only letters, digits, -, _ and .
error_repo_name_taken: A repository with this name already exists here.
fork_private_hint: The source is private, so the fork will be private too.
fork_source_deleted: Fork of a repository that has since been deleted
fork_source_hidden: Fork of a repository you do not have access to
settings_fork_must_stay_private: This is a fork of a private repository and must stay private.
email_button_fallback: If the button doesn't work, copy and paste this link into your browser:
error_email_blocked: This email address is not allowed to register.
admin_blocked_emails_hint: Emails matching any of these wildcard patterns cannot register. Use * for any characters, ? for a single character, e.g. *hacker*.com
admin_gitversion_hint: Manage the MinGit distribution used by this server. Installing a new version does not require an app restart.
admin_gitversion_check_failed: Could not reach GitHub to check for updates.
admin_gitversion_file_too_large: File is too large to preview.
admin_gitversion_file_binary: Binary file, cannot preview as text.
admin_dbmigration_hint: Copy the current SQLite database into an empty SQL Server database.
admin_dbmigration_unavailable_provider: This page only applies while the app is running on SQLite.
admin_dbmigration_run_confirm: Copy all data to SQL Server now?
admin_dbmigration_test_connect_failed: Could not connect to the SQL Server database.
admin_dbmigration_test_not_fresh: This SQL Server database already has migrations applied. Point at a fresh, empty database.
admin_dbmigration_test_ok: Connected. The database is empty and ready to receive data.
admin_dbmigration_run_restart_hint: Now set GitServer:DatabaseProvider to "SqlServer" in appsettings.json and restart the app to start using it.
admin_gitversion_missing_removed: Removed {0} installation(s) whose files were no longer found on disk.
admin_settings_hint: Site-wide toggles. Changes apply immediately, no restart needed.
admin_settings_allow_registration_hint: Let new visitors sign up for an account.
admin_settings_allow_user_repo_creation_: Let signed-in users create repositories from the web UI.
admin_settings_allow_push_to_create_hint: Let a user's first "git push" auto-create the repository, instead of requiring it to exist already.
admin_settings_allow_anonymous_push_hint: Let unauthenticated "git push" write to existing public repositories.
admin_settings_show_commit_avatar_hint: Show the committer's avatar next to each commit in the commit list.
home_intro_text: A self-hosted git server: create repositories, work together through issues and share code, on infrastructure you control.
terms_intro: By using this service you agree to these terms.
terms_s1_text: This service is provided as is, without any warranty of availability, correctness or fitness for a particular purpose. No rights can be derived from the service or from what is stored on it.
terms_s2_text: You are responsible for everything you upload or write here. Do not publish anything unlawful or anything that infringes the rights of others. The administrator may remove content or accounts without notice.
terms_s3_text: You can delete your account at any time. Deleting anonymizes it: your username is replaced by a random anonymous name and your password, email address and profile details are erased. Repositories, issues and comments you created remain visible under that anonymous name.
terms_s4_text: We store your email address, username, display name and the profile details you enter, only to operate this service. We do not sell or share them.
terms_contact: Questions or requests about your data:
error_terms_required: You must accept the terms and conditions to register.
settings_delete_account_help: This anonymizes your account: your name, email address and password are erased and you can no longer sign in. Your repositories, issues and comments remain visible under an anonymous name. This cannot be undone.
settings_delete_account_confirm: Really delete your account? This cannot be undone.
error_last_admin_cannot_delete: You are the last administrator; make someone else an administrator first.
error_account_locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again later.
settings_tokens_help: Use a token instead of your password for git over HTTPS: enter your username and the token as the password. A token can be revoked at any time.
settings_tokens_created: Copy this token now; it is shown only once.
settings_tokens_revoke_confirm: Revoke this token? Anything using it will stop working.
webhooks_hint: A webhook sends a signed JSON POST to a URL when something happens in this repository, for example to start a CI build.
webhook_confirm_delete: Delete this webhook and its delivery history?
webhook_secret_hint: Used to sign each request (header X-Hub-Signature-256, HMAC-SHA256). Leave empty for no signature.
webhook_error_url: Enter a complete http:// or https:// URL.
webhook_error_url_credentials: Do not put a user name or password in the URL; use the secret instead.
webhook_ping_sent: Test sent. Its result appears under recent deliveries in a moment.
admin_settings_private_webhooks: Allow webhooks to this machine and the local network
admin_settings_private_webhooks_hint: Off: webhooks only reach public internet addresses, so repository owners cannot use the server to probe internal services. Turn on to deliver to a CI server on your own network.
lfs_stored_hint: Git holds a small pointer; the file itself is kept in this server's Git LFS storage.
lfs_object_missing: This file is stored with Git LFS, but its content was never uploaded to this server.
settings_error_branch_name: Invalid branch name. Use letters, digits, '.', '_', '-' and '/'.
